supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced 2D extension beyond the outer ocular boundary

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; the muzzle area shows significantly lighter pixel intensity compared to the dark-pigmented periocular and cheek regions

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: macro-scale loss of the superior helix/upper quadrant of the right ear

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: severe truncation or amputation of the upper portion of the right ear pinna
other_distinctive_markers: large, light-colored food bolus or wadge visible within the oral cavity
